title: First Steps
description: The hardest part is showing up. Complete any three workouts in the next fourteen days and you have built the habit that everything else rests on.

title: Streak Starter
description: Five consecutive days with at least one finished workout. Short sessions count, so keep the streak alive even on busy days.

title: Push-up 200
description: Every push-up rep you log in any workout counts. Spread them across sessions or attack them in a few big days.

title: Plank Master
description: Accumulate ten minutes of plank holds over the month. Quality beats duration: a strict 30 seconds is worth more than a sloppy two minutes.

title: Iron Month
description: Three sessions a week for a month. This is the consistency that changes how you look and feel.

title: 10 Tonne Club
description: Total volume across every weighted set you log (reps × kg). Bodyweight moves count only when you add extra load.

title: Time on Task
description: Five hours under the bar this month. Only finished workouts count toward the total.

title: Pull-up 100
description: One hundred strict pull-up reps across the month. Weighted reps count the same as bodyweight ones.
